nodes.code:
from typing import Any


def od_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value).strip() if value is not None else ""


order_id = params["order_id"]
note = od_text(params.get("note"))[:2000] or "Rejected in review"
found = api.records.get(type_slug="od_orders", record_id=order_id) or {}
order: dict[str, Any] = dict(found.get("record") or {})
order_number = od_text(order.get("title"))
stage = od_text(order.get("stage"))
rejected = False
if stage == "released":
    result = "already_released"
else:
    if stage != "rejected":
        api.records.change_stage(type_slug="od_orders", record_id=order_id, stage="rejected", note=note)
    rejected = True
    result = "rejected"

outputs.description: True when the order is now rejected
